name: Firestorm
primary:
The sky burns: fire keeps falling on the chosen spot for thirteen seconds.
A zone at the aim point with a 9-block radius for 16 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 7.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 33 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Blindness for 6 s
• Light push
self_description:
